items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: Then when I was seeing slow drag in 1923. I made him a bass out of box.

ctx.x: Yeah, they used to go out like, or even night most of them. Get out there and start around and see what could they pick up. They're doing good. Then when I was seeing slow drag in 1923. I made him a bass out of box.
